notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the FFLA list places the tower; no build date, design, owner, staffing or access record was found in any source read. Searches did not confirm whether Ponemah lies within the Red Lake reservation (Wikipedia's navigation box lists the reservation but the article text does not say so). Ownership of the land and the tower is unknown; Red Lake Nation or Beltrami County history sources would be the next step. No photos found.
